name: Ulfen Witchguard
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #6-08: Upon Wheels and Rime

items.name: Battle Axe
items.description: These axes are designed explicitly as weapons, rather than tools. They typically weigh less, with a shaft reinforced with metal bands or bolts, and have a sharper blade, making them ideal for chopping limbs rather than wood.

items.name: Shortbow
items.description: This smaller bow is made of a single piece of wood and favored by skirmishers and cavalry.

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

defensiveAbilities.name: Face Me!
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet deals damage to Matriarch Szvetneera

Effect The Ulfen bodyguard lets out a threating bellow at whoever injured their ward. They then attempt a check to Demoralize against the triggering creature, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to the check.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Back Away!
offensiveAbilities.description:
The Ulfen witchguard attacks the target, pushing them back and away from their charge. The witchguard makes a Strike against the creature, then attempts to Shove their target. Depending on the outcome of their Strike, there may be additional effects.

Critical Success The Ulfen witchguard gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their attempt to Shove.

Success The Ulfen witchguard gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their attempt to Shove.

Failure There is no effect.

Critical Failure The Ulfen witchguard is Off-Guard until the start of their next turn.
